notes: Fiscal 2025 ended February 1, 2026 (52 weeks; Home Depot's own label; data.js fy 'Feb 2026'). Filings: Fiscal 2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001628280-26-019436, filed March 18, 2026) and the 2026 proxy statement (accession 0000354950-26-000090, filed April 7, 2026), both read on www.sec.gov. ARTHUR BLANK: co-founder, not a director or officer; he does not appear in the 2026 proxy's beneficial ownership tables (directors, NEOs and holders over 5%), so no stake is reported. HOLDERS: the proxy says the 5% table shows shares 'held as of December 31, 2025' but bases each row 'solely' on a Schedule 13G/A filing (Vanguard December 3, 2025; BlackRock January 26, 2024, which normally reports end-2023 holdings), so asOf is null. Percentages use the March 6, 2026 share count. The proxy adds that Vanguard amended its 13G/A on March 27, 2026 for an internal realignment, after which certain Vanguard subsidiaries and divisions report separately. BUYBACKS: none in fiscal 2025; the 10-K says Home Depot paused repurchases in March 2024 in connection with the SRS acquisition and has no plans to resume them in fiscal 2026, and the 10-K shows a dash for fiscal 2025. STOCK COMP: the note total ($524 million, including ESPP expense); the equity-statement line is $522 million.

taxes.notes: Taxes: total income taxes paid from the Fiscal 2025 10-K income-tax note by jurisdiction (federal 3,590, domestic state and local 799, foreign 459; total 4,848 million), tagged us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet. R&D not reported as a separate line in the Fiscal 2025 10-K (retailer).

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM also holds Home Depot corporate bonds, in a separate row that is not counted. CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the third-quarter 10-Q cover count at November 17, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: the 10-K also estimates about 6,159,000 additional street-name holders.
